latest.title: SpaceX up 8% in premarket after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up

latest.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity

latest.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
latest.description: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

latest.title: United Airlines set to open its biggest airport lounge in $2.6 billion overhaul at Houston hub
latest.description: United is opening a 54,000-square-foot lounge as part of the revamp of Houston's George Bush Intercontinental Airport.

latest.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
latest.description: The signing follows shareholders’ acceptance of Standard Chartered’s non-binding offer in May, with regulatory approvals still pending.

latest.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
latest.description: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

latest.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
latest.description: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.
